There should be a new section explaining how non-crypto fiat buyers receive commissions and prizes. This is crucial for normies: a non-custodial wallet is created for them behind the scenes with no seed phrase, but they may not understand how to access their rewards.
Maybe something along these lines:

"How Does a Non-Crypto Fiat Buyer Collect Commissions and Prizes?":

If you're paying with fiat (credit card, Apple Pay, etc.) and are new to crypto, there's no need to worry—the process is built to be straightforward. When you mint the book for $15 through Transak, a non-custodial wallet is automatically set up for you in the background, with no seed phrase required. That wallet stores your NFT and receives any commissions or prizes.

The process works as follows:
During the Purchase:
Transak converts the fiat to crypto and mints the NFT directly to a newly created wallet address for you.
There is nothing you need to configure manually—the experience is seamless and non-custodial (you control the keys, without having to manage a complicated seed phrase right away).
Your confirmation email will contain your mint number (which is your referral code), the NFT details, and a link to your dashboard on [URL_002].

Earning Commissions ($5 per Referral):
Give people your referral code (for example, "use 8421"). Whenever someone uses it to mint, $5 is sent automatically to your wallet address.
To collect: Sign in to your dashboard on [URL_002], either through the email link or via SIWE with the wallet created by Transak. Your commissions show there instantly, with no action required. If necessary, we'll guide you through exporting to a bank account or exchange (e.g., via Coinbase).

Earning and Winning Prizes (Tickets for $500/$10,000 Draws):
Every referral awards you tickets for the active prize draws, automatically linked to your NFT/wallet.
The draws occur on-chain using fair randomness—every ~100 sales for $500 and every ~10,000 sales for $10,000.
Winners are announced on the Winners page and are also notified by email.

To collect a prize: If you win, the $500 or $10,000 amount is sent directly to your wallet.
Look for notifications in your dashboard/email.

The About page still says prize wins require one-click claiming; the resolved automatic-transfer decision necessarily supersedes that product copy.

process_copy.heading: Mint the ebook NFT
process_copy.body: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_copy.heading: Earn Through Referrals
process_copy.body: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided, the $5 and tickets are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_copy.heading: Build Up Tickets
process_copy.body: Every referral also awards you Small and Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks. More referrals means more tickets and greater chances.

process_copy.heading: Enter the Prize Draws
process_copy.body: Small Block awards 5 × $500 every 500 sales, and Big Block awards 5 × $10,000 every 50,000 sales. Sales include mint and secondary sales. Chainlink VRF selects winners randomly and fairly.

process_copy.heading: Receive Your Rewards
process_copy.body: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page and sent directly to the winner's wallet, with notifications provided through the dashboard and email.

decisions.reason: Referral commissions were already transferred automatically and immediately to the recipient wallet; the source decision changes prize payout only.
Automatic prize delivery does not change the Small Block winner count, award amount, cadence, eligibility, or funding rules.
Prize payout interaction is independent of whether prize-pool deposits generate yield through Aave.
Automatic prize delivery does not change the Big Block winner count, prize amount, or sales-count trigger.
Prize winners remain notified by email regardless of whether payout is automatic or initiated through a claim interaction.
The same-message wallet-provisioning Event already establishes that the provisioned wallet holds prizes; changing the payout interaction requires no further wallet-provisioning state change.
Winner payout method does not alter Big Block ticket issuance, weighting, eligibility, independence, or reset behavior.
Winner payout method does not alter Small Block ticket issuance, weighting, eligibility, carryover, or post-draw reset behavior.
Changing how winners receive awarded prizes does not change primary-mint pricing, commission allocation, founder allocation, or prize-pool funding.
